issues.legal_issue: Expenses incurred to maintain immature, non-bearing plantation trees are deductible when they are non-capital, non-personal expenses incurred wholly and exclusively for the plantation.
material_facts: The estate included rubber plantations, including 235 acres occupied by immature, non-bearing rubber trees.
The assessee claimed deductions for expenses relating to the upkeep and maintenance of the immature trees, including forking and manuring.

The agricultural income-tax tribunal treated expenses on the rubber plantation as deductible and remanded for calculation of expenses relating to the immature areas; the High Court upheld deductibility.
issues.conclusion: The expenses for upkeep of the immature rubber trees were deductible, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(e) of the Madras Plantations Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1955 permits deduction of expenditure that is not capital expenditure or personal expenses and is laid out or expended wholly and exclusively for the purpose of the plantation. The Court applied its decision on the corresponding issue under section 5(j) of the Travancore-Cochin Agricultural Income-tax Act, 1950, in Civil Appeals Nos. 290–292 of 1959.

rule.if: plantation_tax_deduction_case and immature_nonbearing_trees and upkeep_expense_incurred and plantation_purpose_expense and noncapital_nonpersonal_expense

predicates.plantation_tax_deduction_case: The proceeding concerns whether expenditure may be deducted in computing agricultural income from a plantation.
predicates.immature_nonbearing_trees: The plantation includes trees that are immature and not yet bearing produce.
predicates.upkeep_expense_incurred: The taxpayer incurred expenditure to maintain or care for the immature, non-bearing trees.
predicates.plantation_purpose_expense: The expenditure was laid out or expended wholly and exclusively for the purpose of the plantation.
predicates.noncapital_nonpersonal_expense: The expenditure was neither capital expenditure nor a personal expense of the taxpayer.
predicates.immature_tree_upkeep_expense_deductible: The expenditure for upkeep of the immature, non-bearing trees is deductible.

issues.definition: When a plantation tax deduction case involves incurred upkeep expenses for immature, non-bearing trees that serve the plantation and are neither capital nor personal expenses, those expenses are deductible.
